# Vendored: @publik/app-link 0.1.0

Copied from https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/publik at `d21efedf664998464282be92ea2dc4d1a31d975c`.

**Do not edit these files here.** Change them in the publik repo under
`packages/app-link/`, where the tests live, and re-run:

    pnpm applink:vendor <path-to-this-repo>

An edit made only here is invisible to the other eight apps and to the test
suite, which is the failure mode vendoring is otherwise prone to.
